source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Chapter 7 summary (PDF 191).

items: “Terms of Use”, jinhein Terms and Conditions ya Terms of Service bhi kehte hain, qanooni muahide (legal agreements) hain jo batate hain ke koi service ya product kaise istemal ho sakta hai.
Terms of Use todne ke sangeen qanooni nataij ho sakte hain: user par jurmana, muqadma, ya service istemal karne par pabandi.
Terms of Use ke akhlaqi pehlu: fairness (insaf), transparency (saaf goi) aur user ke huqooq ka ehtaram.
Terms of Use mein personal rights: privacy ka haq, maloomat milne ka haq, aur consent (razamandi) wapas lene ka haq.
Spam woh unwanted messages hain jo email ya phone par aate hain.
Spyware nuqsan deh software hai jo chupke se dekhta hai ke aap computer ya phone par kya karte hain.
Cookies chhoti files hain jo websites aap ke device par rakh deti hain jab aap unhein kholte hain.
Phishing ek dhoka hai jis mein koi bharose wala idara ban kar aap se personal maloomat nikalwata hai.
Antivirus software computer ko spyware jaise nuqsan deh programs se bachata hai.
Cookies chhoti files hain jo websites aap ke computer par store karti hain. (Kitab ne cookies ki tareef do dafa likhi hai.)
Digital divide bridge karne ka matlab hai ke sab ko technology aur internet tak barabar rasai mile.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Summary sirf chand baatein dohrati hai. Chapter mein pharming, digital divide ki wajoohat aur asraat, maloomat parakhne ke saat qadam, computing ke musbat aur manfi asraat aur digital citizenship bhi hain; inhein apne apne lesson mein dekhein.
